title: Majority Element
constraints: The majority element always exists in the array.

examples.explanation: 5 appears twice in a three-element array, which is more than half.

solutionApproaches.title: Frequency Map
solutionApproaches.explanation: Count every value and return the one whose count exceeds half of the array length.

solutionApproaches.title: Boyer-Moore Voting
solutionApproaches.explanation: Maintain a candidate and a count. Increment count on match, decrement on mismatch. Reset when count hits zero.
